svg.title: Step 2: who are they, then and now?
svg.desc: A request arrives from an email the person stopped using. The agent looks up their history: signed up with an old email, later changed phone and email. Every identifier goes on one key ring: new email, old email, phone, email hash and the stable user ID that many records use instead of an email. Plain lookups, no AI, no guessing.
svg.text: Who are they, then and now?
People change emails and phones. Old copies of their data still use the old ones.
all of them go on one key ring
One request, every identifier they ever had. Plain lookups: no AI, no guessing.
